Über TradeLink
TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen.
Mit KI als Hebel trägst du die volle Verantwortung für strategische Enterprise-Accounts - vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Verlängerung und zum Ausbau der Partnerschaft. Dabei bist du weit mehr als Verkäufer:in: Du berätst Head of Logistics & Co. auf ihrem Weg in die AI-Transformation, zeigst ihnen, was mit agentischer KI in ihrer Lieferkette möglich wird, und bringst sie an die vorderste Front dieser Entwicklung - gemeinsam mit uns.
Aufgaben
Neukunden gewinnen & AI-Transformation gestalten: Du erschließt strategische Enterprise-Accounts - und wirst zum vertrauten Berater ihrer AI-Reise. Du hilfst Enterprise Kunden / Logistik Teams das Potenzial agentischer KI zu erkennen und zu heben, und positionierst sie (und TradeLink) an der Spitze der Supply-Chain-Innovation. Von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Abschluss: Du verkaufst nicht nur ein Produkt, du eröffnest eine neue Art zu arbeiten.
Bestehende Accounts ausbauen: Du entwickelst dein Kundenbuch aktiv weiter - von der klassischen Slotbooking-Nutzung hin zu unserem neuen AI Promise-Produkt und in weitere agentische Workflows hinein.
Probleme verstehen, bevor du Lösungen anbietest: Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst die operativen Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen wirklich - und übersetzt sie in konkrete AI-Chancen und selbst aufgebaute Pipeline, statt auf eingehende Anfragen zu warten.
Workshops mit Entscheider:innen führen: Du planst und moderierst Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen, die Klarheit schaffen und den nächsten kommerziellen Schritt definieren.
Onboarding & Rollout absichern: Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Builder - deinem technischen Tandem-Partner - sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden sauber onboarded werden und technische Anfragen zügig gelöst werden.
KI als Hebel nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem GTM Engineering zusammen, um KI-gestützte Prozesse in deinem Vertriebsalltag laufend zu verbessern.
Qualifikation
>5 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Account Management mit Enterprise-Kunden, inklusive eigenständig abgeschlossener Deals mit einem Vertragswert von mindestens €50.000
Praktische Erfahrung darin, KI in den eigenen Sales-Prozess zu integrieren - über reines Prompting hinaus
Erfahrung in Planung, Durchführung und erfolgreichem Abschluss von Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen
Die Fähigkeit, schwierige Priorisierungsentscheidungen zu treffen und diese mit klarer eigener Argumentation zu vertreten
Echte Neugier : Du willst Kundenprobleme wirklich verstehen, bevor du über Lösungen sprichst
Freude an Verhandlungen und am Aufbau von Beziehungen - auch unaufgefordert und über den aktuellen Deal hinaus
Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams - Product, Engineering oder Solution Consulting sind von Vorteil
Branchennähe zu Logistik, Supply Chain oder angrenzenden operativen B2B-Umfeldern wären optimal

Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme.
AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben.
Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern.
Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools.
Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München.
Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens
Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten.
TradeLink ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt eine große Stärke ist, und setzt sich für ein respektvolles, sicheres und offenes Umfeld für alle ein, die bei oder mit uns arbeiten. Um unbewusste Vorurteile im Bewerbungsprozess zu reduzieren, kannst du dein Bewerbungsfoto gern weglassen.

Who We Are Chomps is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors.

Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG.

Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project.

Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com . Traits of a Chompian If you’ve been called scrappy, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented.

You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data.

You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you?

Then we want to meat you. * Accepting applications from 7/17/26 - 7/24/26 What You Will Do We are looking for a high energy, highly motivated, and creative person to join the team as our Account Manager, Club Channel.

The Account Manager, Club Channel is responsible for delivering the revenue, distribution and trade funding objectives for the channel in accordance with company sales plans and budgets. This individual must be an experienced, motivated, inspired, organized, creative, willing to roll up their sleeves with a strong work ethic.

This individual will report to and partner with Senior Director of Sales, Club to rapidly scale the business.

Responsibilities Achieve Fiscal Year Financials Direct and deliver key financial metrics versus Plan within aligned trade spend plan Account Plan management, contributing to both current year and long-range plan forecasts Ability to operate in ever changing customer/competitive landscape & able to adjust strategy ongoing to hit KPI’s Customer Development & Execution Work with the Senior Director of Club Channel to create long term, thought leadership visions for customer accounts.

Achieve new item, assortment, pricing, and merchandising objectives set forth for specific customer objectives Manage the forecast, in partnership with the Business Analytics Team Build relationships with each regional Buying Office, creating long-term partnership & strategic synergies.

Extremely detail oriented in day to day fulfillment/PO management; ensuring product arrives to correct facilities on time. Build yearly rotational strategy for customer/region that hits on all of Chomps LRP goals. Strong data acumen, to build best in class selling materials to influence Buying decisions in the Club Channel.

Effectively engage and leverage cross functional resources (Brokers, Business Development team, Shopper Marketing, eCommerce, Finance, Supply Chain) to exceed/achieve business objectives Customer Meeting Support: coordinate sales/review/innovation presentations at customers leveraging cross-functional support to enable team selling approach.

Capabilities You bring creative solutions for rapid growth; and have the follow up to execute on ideas.

You build strong cross functional relationships, both internally and externally You take your work seriously, but yourself lightly Who You Are 4+ years of experience in Consumer Packaged Goods industry Previously experience working with or at key retailers is a must: Costco, Sam’s Club or BJ’s Wholesale Has worked in high stakes negotiations with large retailers previously Excellent interpersonal, networking and relationship building skills!

This person can start conversations with anyone and create a positive association with Chomps brand Very strong team player, ability to work with cross-functional teams to get results Experience in sales planning, trade management and forecasting Ability to multi-task and work in fast-paced, high demand environment Self-sufficient and highly detailed oriented Passion for natural and organic products Ability to travel for trade shows, sales calls, and meetings – approximately 40% of time Bachelor's degree Must be an analytical thinker and data-driven; strong data analysis skills and experience working with IRI/Nielsen and/or Retail POS data Have worked with trade management and demand planning software Strong PC skills including online applications, MS Office Position : Account Manager - Club Reports to : Senior Director, Sales - Club Location : Remote Type : Full-Time, exempt Salary Range Opportunity: The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $115,000 + 20% annual bonus Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp: Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks: Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry. Opportunities to grow: Advance within Chomps quickly based on outstanding performance. Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule.

Chicago office open to those in the area. Paid maternity and paternity leave. Bi-annual total team in-person activities. Company-wide Continual Education budget. Unlimited snacks: Enough meat sticks that if you wanted to eat your body weight in them you could (no judgment here).

Our Commitment Chomps is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of making nutritious food more accessible we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization.

Achieving true diversity and inclusion is the right thing to do and the smart thing for our business. We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria.

Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Chomps . You must reside in the United States to be considered for this position.

Chomps does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Important Notice: It has come to our attention that fraudsters have been posing as Chomps employees or recruiters and contacting job-seeking candidates regarding potential job opportunities. These fraudulent messages sometimes include a request for payment and confidential personal information.

Please note that the Chomps recruiting process does not include asking candidates for payments or other confidential financial information. If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles: https://chomps.com/pages/chomps-careers .

If you have questions please email us at people@chomps.com Originally posted on Himalayas

Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud. We’re transforming the software industry. We’re Flexera .

With more than 50,000 customers across the world, we’re achievingthat goal.Butwe knowwe can’t do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans?

Come and see why we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace.Learn more at flexera.com As an Enterprise Account Executive , you will be responsible for selling the Flexera One platform to a curated list of enterprise accounts within a designated vertical.

You will play a pivotal role in Flexera ’s growth strategy by nurturing and expanding relationships with existing customers, while also targeting and securing new logos. You will be accountable for meeting and exceeding your annual quota through effective prospecting, strategic account planning, and accurate forecasting.

Address customer objections and concerns, providing solutions and building trust Navigate and overcome barriers related to migration, cost, security, and performance to drive successful outcomes Negotiate favorable pricing and contractual agreements that align with Flexera and client expectations Qualifications & Experience: Experience selling software solutions (cloud, cloud cost, cloud management, ITSM, ITAM/SAM, data, security, risk management, application resource management) Experience utilizing a defined sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger) for business needs and pain understanding Proven success in uncovering opportunities with both net new and existing accounts through creative prospecting and hunting activities.

Full ownership of the end-to-end sales process (not an overlay role). Strong reputation for exceeding sales quota Consultative sales experience targeting relevant companies/businesses to drive cost savings and efficiencies throughout their IT organization Flexera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Senior Sales Director, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA

The Senior Sales Manager, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, channel management, and business growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection portfolio, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, customer satisfaction, and profitability throughout the region.
The position has full responsibility for regional sales performance, distributor network optimization, key account management, forecasting accuracy, business planning, and the development of high-performing sales teams.

The incumbent will collaborate closely with global commercial leadership, product management, marketing, service, operations, and channel partners to drive business success and support Thermo Fisher Scientific's mission of making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer and will report to the Director MCS EMEA

Commercial Leadership
Develop and execute the regional commercial strategy for Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection across EMEA.
Deliver or exceed annual revenue, order booking, profitability, and market share objectives.
Establish regional growth initiatives aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business plans.
Identify emerging market opportunities and develop expansion strategies across government, defense, homeland security, customs, critical infrastructure, transportation, nuclear, and industrial sectors.
Lead regional pricing strategies and commercial negotiations to maximize profitability and competitive positioning.
Sales Management
Lead, coach, and develop Regional Sales Managers and commercial team members across EMEA.
Establish clear performance objectives and accountability measures for direct and indirect reports.
Drive a high-performance sales culture focused on customer engagement, operational excellence, and growth.
Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and execution against strategic objectives.
Ensure effective territory management and resource allocation across the region.
Channel & Distributor Management
Manage and optimize the regional distributor network.
Evaluate distributor performance and implement improvement plans where required.
Recruit, develop, and train new distributors to support strategic growth objectives.
Identify opportunities to streamline channel structures and improve market coverage.
Ensure distributors maintain appropriate product knowledge, compliance standards, and customer support capabilities.
Strategic Account Management
Develop executive-level relationships with key customers, government agencies, strategic accounts, and channel partners.
Lead commercial negotiations for complex and high-value opportunities.
Support global account initiatives and coordinate multi-country opportunities.
Manage critical customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of business issues.
Drive customer retention and long-term partnership development.
Business Planning & Forecasting
Develop and execute annual regional business plans.
Own forecast accuracy, pipeline management, and sales reporting.
Utilize CRM tools to manage opportunities, customer segmentation, and business intelligence.
Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer requirements to support decision-making.
Present business reviews and growth plans to executive leadership.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Collaborate with Product Management, Marketing, Service, Operations, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering teams.
Lead regional implementation of new product launches and commercial initiatives.
Participate in global strategic projects and business transformation initiatives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, integrations, and organizational change activities where applicable.
Customer Experience & Operational Excellence
Ensure customer satisfaction objectives are consistently achieved or exceeded.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across commercial processes.
Promote a customer-centric culture throughout the organization.
Support resolution of complex service, technical, and commercial issues.
Ensure compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and ethical business practices.
Industry Representation
Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, trade shows, workshops, and government forums.
Build strategic relationships with industry leaders, regulatory authorities, and key stakeholders.
Act as a recognized commercial leader within the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection markets.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Science, Technology, or related discipline.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
As a Salesforce Account Executive , you'll work closely with our VP of Sales, Enterprise, and CEO and be an integral part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, Sales team focused on the Health and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical within Salesforce.

You will manage all aspects of the sales process including lead management, creating pipeline, qualification, evaluation, close, and strong account management, and will play a vital role in the success of the overall sales team.

This is an incredible opportunity for someone who is ready to make an immediate impact in their career with a well-established brand and dive into the world of AI and Salesforce.

Perform as a key employee in the role of Account Executive, with a focus on winning new business, driving pipeline, and building trust and strong relationships with our customers
Tightly partner with the Salesforce sales and customer success organizations including: Core AE’s and SE’s in the HLS organization
Be a leader at NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture by being the “quarterback” with our customers, Salesforce employees, and internal teammates to ensure high satisfaction maintaining and growing our strong brand
Be a quota-carrying top sales performer focused on new logos who is looking to learn and innovate to help the company meet its sales and high-growth targets
Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and the CEO to continually take advantage of new market opportunities
Help maintain updated lead follow-up, tasks, pipeline, and forecasting in Salesforce
Continuously ensure the highest possible level of Customer Experience (for NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture's customers, and our partner Salesforce), by delivering quality and timely responses

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions.

The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.
The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax's unwavering mission.
Ajax Systems is a Ukrainian success story, a place of incredible strength and energy. Qualifications & Skills:

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Aufgaben
Führung
Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.
Kunden
Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.

Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.
Fachlichkeit & Prozesse
Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.
Qualifikation
Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).
Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.
Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …
… du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
… du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
… du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.
… du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.
… du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

Ein Team, das dir gehört — und die Freiheit, es zu formen.
Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.
Halbjährliche Entwicklungsgespräche mit echtem Feedback statt Formularen. Gehalt wird bei uns nach System vergeben, nicht nach Verhandlungsgeschick.
Führungskräfte-Ausbildung mit einem externen Coach, der Führungsteams bei Meta und in mehreren Scale-ups aufgebaut hat.
100 % remote, überall in Deutschland — plus regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations.
MacBook, bei Bedarf zusätzliche Hardware.
50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit.
Sechs Sätze, an denen wir uns messen lassen — auch als Führungskraft:
Be confident.
We don't need all the answers to start, just the grit to find them first.
Be curious.
Let's be obsessed to find the ‚Why‘ to unlock the ‚How‘.
Keep growing.
Treat yourself like brilliant software: ship a new upgrade every month.
Be accountable.
Openness over cosiness. We own our words.
Act entrepreneurial.

Job Description About ScholarshipOwl
ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S. , connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

Reports to: Director of Sales
Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.
This role runs in two gears : sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.
In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle . From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.
What You'll Be Selling
Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid.

We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale .
What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.
ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer , and a second motion alongside SSC.

Relentless Prospecting: Execute high-volume daily outbound campaigns (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to hunt for net-new opportunities and consistently book discovery meetings .
Full-Cycle Ownership: Run the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and aggressive qualification to running product demos, sending proposals, and closing deals .
Data-Driven Pipeline Triage: Actively manage your sales funnel within HubSpot, performing regular pipeline reviews to prioritize high-value opportunities and ruthlessly cut weak leads .
Drive Revenue & Velocity: Take absolute ownership of your targets, driving urgency in deal cycles to progress opportunities through late-stage negotiations and contract signing.
Hit Major Milestones: Our sales cycle runs four to six months, so your first quarter is about building. Deliver $175–300K in qualified pipeline (approx. 20–30 qualified meetings ) in your first 90 days , and close your first net-new deal within six months .
Iterate & Optimize: Continuously refine your outreach messaging and campaign targeting based on performance metrics to maximize conversion rates.

Must-Haves
3+ Years of B2B Sales Experience: A proven track record of exceeding quotas in a full-cycle B2B sales or business development role (prospecting through to close).
"Hunter" Mentality & Dialing Discipline: You have a high drive, resilience in the face of rejection, and a proven daily discipline for outbound cold calling .
Pipeline Mastery: Strong proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) paired with immaculate data hygiene , accurate notes, and clear deal-stage tracking.
Exceptional Execution: Proven ability to run tight discovery calls , command proposal conversations, control the sales narrative, and push multi-stakeholder deals across the finish line .
Communication Excellence: Advanced English proficiency with exceptional presentation and relationship-building skills across phone, Zoom, email, and Slack.

Experience using advanced outbound workflows or AI-driven discovery tools like Clay .
Familiarity with mid-market sales cycles (4–6 months) involving multi-stakeholder decision-making.
A background working within high-growth startup or fast-paced SMB environments.
Nice-to-Haves
Educational Foundation: Holds a Bachelor’s degree (though we highly value proven sales grit and revenue results over formal education).
Targeted Industry Experience: Experience selling into Directors, CMOs, Growth, or Brand leaders —ideally within marketing, lead generation, digital acquisition, or performance models.
U.S. Market Exposure: Familiarity with U.S. business culture , the U.S. education/scholarship landscape, or holding a degree from a U.S.-based institution.

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

## Required ##
* Bachelor-s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
* 0-2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
* Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.
* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
* Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

Über 600 großartige Unternehmen, darunter bofrost, Schwarzwaldmilch, der 1. FC Köln, TÜV Rheinland oder Schweppes, vertrauen bereits auf unsere Lösung.
Unser Antrieb: Mittelstandsunternehmen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle für eine nachhaltige Wirtschaft. Doch ESG, CSRD, CO₂-Bilanzen & Co. sind oft komplex, zeitaufwendig und ressourcenintensiv. Genau hier setzen wir an – mit leistungsstarker Software, die Komplexität einfach macht, fundiertem Know-how und einem Team, das echten Impact schafft.
Jetzt suchen wir dich: eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die den Aufbau und die Skalierung unseres neuen ISO-Geschäftsbereichs in der DACH-Region maßgeblich verantwortet und bei führenden Unternehmen in der DACH‑Region etabliert. Mit deinem Drive, deinem strategischen Sales‑Mindset und deinem Fokus auf Abschlüsse führst du anspruchsvolle Deals souverän durch den gesamten Funnel und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zu unserem Umsatzwachstum.
Aufgaben
Strategische Neukundenentwicklung: Du identifizierst, adressierst und gewinnst eigenständig relevante Entscheider:innen in mittelständischen Unternehmen und Konzernen – insbesondere aus den Bereichen ESHQ, ISO, Qualität, Fachabteilungen sowie auf C-Level. Über Telefon, E-Mail, Social Selling und digitale Kanäle baust du belastbare Erstkontakte und nachhaltige Beziehungen auf.
Discovery Calls & Bedarfsanalyse: Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche und Potenzialanalysen durch, erkennst durch aktives Zuhören relevante Pain Points und entwickelst darauf basierend passgenaue Nutzenargumentationen.
Produkt‑Demonstrationen: Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen in klar strukturierten Produkt‑Demos (remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort), erklärst komplexe Dienstleistungen verständlich und berätst potenzielle Kund:innen zielorientiert.
Pipeline‑Management & Lead‑Entwicklung: Du baust eine belastbare Opportunity‑Pipeline auf, priorisierst Leads eigenständig und entwickelst sie durch systematische Follow-ups weiter. Zudem vertiefst du den Austausch mit Interessent:innen und unterstützt bei Fachmessen sowie relevanten Branchenevents.
Angebotserstellung & Vertragsabschluss: Du erstellst überzeugende Angebote, führst Verhandlungen und bringst ausgewählte Deals eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss.
End-to-End Ownership & Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du steuerst laufende Opportunities mit hoher Transparenz bis zum Closing und gewährleistest eine strukturierte Übergabe an das Account Management. Du hast ein Gespür für Trends im Food\-Markt und willst nicht nur analysieren, sondern aktiv gestalten?
Dann übernimm bei uns eine Schlüsselrolle im Business Development und bring neue Produkte, Märkte und Ideen erfolgreich voran.
**Diese Tätigkeit ist deine Leidenschaft**
Im Zentrum steht das tiefe Verständnis der Kernmärkte – ihrer Länder, Kundensegmente und Bedürfnisse. Du analysierst, recherchierst und identifizierst und leitest daraus Potenziale und Trends ab. Die nötige Marktnähe gewinnst du im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und den Tochtergesellschaften – ergänzend an ausgewählten Messen und Events. Um an die entscheidenden Informationen zu gelangen, baust du Allianzen und ein tragfähiges Netzwerk mit Industrie\-, Handels\- und Foodservice\-Partnern auf.
Deine Erkenntnisse verdichtest du zu Trendanalysen, Business Cases und Forecasts, die strategische Entscheidungen stützen.

Im Marktteam tauschst du dich eng mit Produktmanagement, Technik und Verkauf aus, bringst relevante Market Insights aus den einzelnen Ländern ein und gibst damit auch Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Serviceleistungen.

Gleichzeitig bereitest du deine Erkenntnisse so auf, dass der Verkauf daraus konkrete Go\-to\-Market\-Strategien entwickeln kann und die Geschäftsleitung eine fundierte Grundlage für die Weiterentwicklung der Unternehmens\- und Marktstrategie erhält.
In den Austauschrunden mit den Verkaufsteams hinterfragst du eingefahrene Muster, bringst neue Perspektiven ein und überzeugst mit Fakten – hier ist Durchsetzungsvermögen gefragt. Kurz gesagt: Deine Arbeit verbindet Analyse und Recherche mit Netzwerk, Kommunikation und Überzeugungskraft.
**Das erwartet dich bei uns**
Herz – Tradition – Pioniergeist! Dies umschreibt die Werte von RONDO. Vertrauen schenken – gemeinsam wachsen, Wort halten und Sorge tragen, Mut haben und Neues wagen. Du trittst in ein respektvolles, menschenorientiertes und familiäres Unternehmensumfeld ein, in dem du deine Begeisterung für Kunden in einem internationalen Marktumfeld einbringen kannst.
**Deine Expertise überzeugt uns**
Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Lebensmitteltechnologie, Agrarwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Marktstrukturen und Trends mit. Du erfasst rasch komplexe Zusammenhänge, arbeitest methodisch, strukturiert und eigenständig und denkst analytisch wie strategisch.

In der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit trittst du überzeugend und mit dem nötigen Durchsetzungsvermögen auf. Deutsch ist für die Zusammenarbeit am Standort Burgdorf zwingend, Englisch für das internationale Geschäft; für die nötige Präsenz vor Ort bist du idealerweise regional verankert.
**Interessiert?**
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Foto, welche du uns unter Angabe der **Referenznummer 26\-2224** per E\-Mail zustellst. Diskretion ist für uns oberstes Gebot; deshalb behandeln wir auch deine Unterlagen unter Berücksichtigung dieses Anspruches.
